items.source_en: Subject: Where'd she get this thing? Date: 05-13-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell We picked up the ship and are on our way to the depot. I can see why Lysi got a deal on this: the hyperdrive is absolute garbage. And was it you that set the computer to French? This some kind of joke? Har har. I can pilot this thing, but that's about all "Mademoiselle" will let me do. I don't care what Lysi says, I vote we drop this hunk of junk into a star when we're done. Subject: Mission Accomplished (You're welcome) Date: 05-14-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell While you were in Nar Shaddaa getting high off fish, I was shaking hands with a Galactic Empire quartermaster and trying to convince him that my computer speaks French because I just love learning useless languages. If he'd have been 1% more suspicious Lysi and I would in an interrogation room right now, singing your name. Or dead. We're on our way to the rendezvous point. I've turned off everything to avoid the sharks' scanners. Gravity should do the rest. Don't be late. Subject: You're late Date: 05-14-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt and assume ISB is looking for us, forcing you to take the long way around. And to not reply to our messages. Your girl's voice is driving me crazy. Hurry up. Subject: You're a monster Date: 05-15-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell Water and oxygen recycling stopped. I've tried restarting the engines and pushing us back toward civilization but this POS computer won't let me do a goddamn thing. Did you lock me out? Was this your plan, you little coward? Subject: I figured it out Date: 05-16-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell Your girl keeps calling me crabby, says I should sleep. That's when she's supposed to kill me, right? Then she signals you to drop in? Did she sabotage the jump drive or was it you? I could be wrong. Lysi certainly denies it. But tell you what, Rick. I'm not laying down. I'm not closing my eyes. items.legacy_ko: 제목: 이 물건은 어디서 난 거지? 날짜: 2329-05-13 수신: 릭 루아젤 발신: 조니 오웰 우리가 함선을 챙겨서 보급창으로 향하고 있다. 리시가 왜 이 물건을 싸게 샀는지 알겠군. 하이퍼드라이브가 완전히 쓰레기야. 그리고 컴퓨터 언어를 프랑스어로 설정한 게 너냐? 무슨 장난이라도 치는 거야? 하하, 웃기지도 않는군. 내가 이 배를 조종할 수는 있지만, 그 '마드무아젤'이 허락하는 건 딱 거기까지야. 리시가 뭐라 하든, 난 일이 끝나면 이 고철 덩어리를 별에 처박아 버리는 데 한 표 던지겠다. 제목: 임무 완수 (천만에) 날짜: 2329-05-14 수신: 릭 루아젤 발신: 조니 오웰 네가 나 샤다에서 물고기나 빨며 취해 있을 때, 난 은하 제국 보급 장교와 악수하며 내 컴퓨터가 프랑스어를 쓰는 건 내가 쓸모없는 언어 배우기를 좋아해서 그렇다고 설득하느라 진땀을 뺐다. 그놈이 1%만 더 의심했어도 리시와 나는 지금쯤 심문실에 앉아 네 이름을 불고 있었을 거다. 아니면 죽었거나. 우린 약속 장소로 향하고 있다. 놈들의 스캐너를 피하려고 모든 장치를 꺼뒀어. 중력이 나머지를 해결해 줄 거다. 늦지 마라. 제목: 늦었잖아 날짜: 2329-05-14 수신: 릭 루아젤 발신: 조니 오웰 ISB가 우리를 쫓고 있어서 네가 멀리 돌아오느라 메시지에 답도 못 하는 거라고 좋게 생각해주마. 네 여자 목소리 때문에 미치겠군. 서둘러라. 제목: 넌 괴물이야 날짜: 2329-05-15 수신: 릭 루아젤 발신: 조니 오웰 물과 산소 재순환 장치가 멈췄다. 엔진을 재시동하고 문명권으로 돌아가려고 애써봤지만, 이 빌어먹을 컴퓨터가 아무것도 못 하게 막고 있어. 네가 잠가둔 거냐? 이게 네 계획이었나, 이 겁쟁이 자식아? 제목: 알아냈다 날짜: 2329-05-16 수신: 릭 루아젤 발신: 조니 오웰 네 여자가 자꾸 나보고 까칠하다며 잠이나 자라고 하더군. 그때가 바로 날 죽이려는 타이밍이지, 그렇지? 그러고 나서 네가 나타나라고 신호를 보내는 거고? 점프 드라이브를 망가뜨린 게 그녀냐, 아니면 너냐? 내가 틀렸을 수도 있지. 리시는 당연히 아니라고 하더군. 하지만 잘 들어, 릭. 난 순순히 당하지 않아. 눈도 안 감을 거다. 사실, 24시간 안에 네가 나타나지 않으면 여기 있는 네 파트너를 목 졸라 죽여야 할지도 모르겠군. 서둘러라. -조니 오웰

locations.vanilla_source_en: Subject: Where'd she get this thing? Date: 05-13-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell We picked up the ship and are on our way to the depot. I can see why Lysi got a deal on this: the grav drive is absolute garbage. And was it you that set the computer to French? This some kind of joke? Har har. I can pilot this thing, but that's about all "Mademoiselle" will let me do. I don't care what Lysi says, I vote we drop this hunk of junk into a star when we're done. Subject: Mission Accomplished (You're welcome) Date: 05-14-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell While you were in Neon getting high off fish, I was shaking hands with a United Colonies quartermaster and trying to convince him that my computer speaks French because I just love learning useless languages. If he'd have been 1% more suspicious Lysi and I would in an interrogation room right now, singing your name. Or dead. We're on our way to the rendezvous point. I've turned off everything to avoid the sharks' scanners. Gravity should do the rest. Don't be late. Subject: You're late Date: 05-14-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell I'm going to give you the benefit of the doubt and assume SysDef is looking for us, forcing you to take the long way around. And to not reply to our messages. Your girl's voice is driving me crazy. Hurry up. Subject: You're a monster Date: 05-15-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell Water and oxygen recycling stopped. I've tried restarting the engines and pushing us back toward civilization but this POS computer won't let me do a goddamn thing. Did you lock me out? Was this your plan, you little coward? Subject: I figured it out Date: 05-16-2329 To: Rick Loiselle From: Johnny Orwell Your girl keeps calling me crabby, says I should sleep. That's when she's supposed to kill me, right? Then she signals you to drop in? Did she sabotage the jump drive or was it you? I could be wrong. Lysi certainly denies it. But tell you what, Rick. I'm not laying down. I'm not closing my eyes. In fact, if you're not here within 24 hours I might have to strangle your partner here. Hurry up. -Johnny Orwell
